infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Blades uses the camera to scan your paper logbook pages, ACARS and instrument displays, and drone flight logs, so the details can be filled in for you.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Blades uses your photo library to attach and match photos and videos to your flights (these stay on your device), and to import images of logbook pages, ACARS displays or drone flight logs that you choose to scan.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Blades uses your location to show distances and directions to airports, mark off-airport landing sites and work out night time for drone flights. Your location stays on your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Blades saves images you choose to keep, such as flight share cards, to your photo library.
